questions.q: What is the form of this chapter?
choices: A single scene with Kumalo and Msimangu
A chorus of many anonymous voices about the housing shortage and the making of Shanty Town
questions.explain: It opens 'All roads lead to Johannesburg' and moves through many unnamed speakers.

questions.q: What refrain runs through the chapter?
questions.explain: The desperate search for lodging is asked and refused over and over.

questions.q: In the itemised weekly budget, how much is left for food for a family of six?
questions.explain: After rent, travel, burial insurance, books, clothes, church and sickness, 'that leaves seventeen shillings for food for six, and we are always hungry.'

questions.q: How long can people wait on the list for a municipal house?
choices: Five or six years — one man is told he is 'about number six thousand on the list'
It is instant if you apply
questions.explain: A bribe can move your name up, but 'the European manager has said that he will deal severely with any who tamper with the list.'

questions.q: What confuses Mrs Seme when a man says his wife wants to discuss 'the work of the Committee'?
choices: She has never heard of any committee — it is really a coded offer to arrange a bribe for a house
The man has mistaken her for someone else entirely
The committee wants her to join it
questions.explain: 'He wants to discuss with you the money you are willing to pay for a house.'

questions.q: Whose plan is it to build Shanty Town?
choices: Dubula's — build your own houses on the open ground by the railway line at Orlando
questions.explain: Each family pays a shilling a week to the committee, which arranges lavatories so there is no sickness.

questions.q: Where do the people get the materials to build Shanty Town?
choices: They quietly take planks, corrugated iron, sacks and poles from the hospital, the reformatory, a station and the mines
They buy them from a merchant
questions.explain: 'Shanty Town is up overnight' — sacks, planks and iron, with a shilling to the Committee and no rent.

questions.q: What happens to the sick child in Shanty Town?
choices: The Committee sends a black doctor, but the child dies before he can help
She is taken to hospital in time
questions.explain: 'We do not need the doctor any more. No white doctor, no black doctor can help her any more.'

questions.q: How do the white authorities respond after Shanty Town appears?
choices: First they photograph it and start building rough houses; then, when more squatters arrive, the police come and drive people away
They give everyone a proper house at once
questions.explain: Pity turns to anger when squatters from Pimville, Alexandra and Sophiatown also put up shacks.

questions.q: What is sung round a fire in Shanty Town at night?
questions.explain: 'God save this piece of Africa that is my own, delivered in travail from my body.'
